description: Prototype API for a persistent assistant pane in Thunderbird mail tabs.

events.name: onWidthChanged
events.description: Fires after the operator resizes the assistant pane.

functions.name: initialize
functions.description: Sets the default pane width for newly registered mail tabs.

functions.name: ensureButton
functions.description: Adds the assistant-pane toggle to a Thunderbird mail tab.

functions.name: toggle
functions.description: Toggles the assistant pane in a Thunderbird mail tab.

functions.name: close
functions.description: Closes the assistant pane in a Thunderbird mail tab.
